name: archaeological-artifact-drawing
title_zh: 拓片照片进，出版级SVG线图出，比例尺纹饰自动对齐
tagline_zh: 考古报告配图不用再手描三天。正投影、剖面、纹饰、比例尺自动提取，输出符合出版规范的矢量线图，连拓片褶皱都帮你理直。
tagline_en: Stop hand-tracing artifact photos for days. Auto-extract orthographic views, profiles, motifs & scales into.
desc_en: Use when archaeological artifact photographs, measured data, rubbings, or finished line drawings need analysis, measured drawing, review, or standardization; 适用于考古器物、正投影、剖面、纹饰、比例尺、实测绘图、拓片、出版图版和 SVG 矢量输出。
why_zh: 不是滤镜式描边，而是按考古绘图规范重建几何：先校正投影畸变，再分层提取结构线、纹饰与比例尺。
why_en: Not a tracing filter—it rebuilds geometry per archaeological drawing standards: corrects projection distortion, then separates.
limit_zh: 只认单件器物的正投影或拓片照片；复杂叠压关系、残缺拼接需人工预判。输出为SVG线稿，不生成器物复原图或彩色渲染。
limit_en: Only for single-artifact orthographic photos or rubbings; complex overlaps/joins need manual prep. Outputs SVG line art only—no reconstructions or.
title_en: From photos/rubbings to publication-ready SVG line drawings
